knowledgeAnswers.rationale: The hierarchy puts source controls first and personal protection last.
A seal check is done each time, because the seal can be lost between uses.
A failed seal means no protection. Leave the area and report.

practicalCriteria: Carries out a user seal check before wearing a respirator, and records the result.
Stops and leaves the area when a simulated seal fails.
Reports a damaged filter and does not start the task.
passRule: Seal check passed before the task, and failed seal or damaged filter stopped and reported. Observed by an assessor. Not a fit-testing certificate.
stopWorkCriteria: Seal check failed and task started
Wrong respirator type for the material
